Highlights:
## LEGEND 900 PRO PCIe Gen4 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

The leader in creative style! LEGEND 900 PRO SSD delivers advanced computing performance to creators. With sequential read/write speeds of up to 7,400/6,500MB per second and a storage capacity of 2TB, it is a powerful first choice for expanding PS5 console storage and supports the latest Intel and AMD platforms.

### Features Ordering Information

| ● PCIe Gen4 x4 transmission interface | Capacity | Model Number | EAN Code | UPC Code |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ● R/W speed up to 7,400/6,500 MB/s | 4TB | SLEG-900P-4TCS | 4711658153616 | 842243036718 |
| ● Compliant with NVMe 1.4 | 2TB | SLEG-900P-2TCS | 4711658150707 | 842243035537 |
| ● Work with PS5 | 1TB | SLEG-900P-1TCS | 4711658150691 | 842243035520 |

● Supports Host Memory Buffer (HMB) 
● SLC caching 
● Advanced hardware LDPC ECC Technology 
● Value-added software: SSD Toolbox 

### Specifications

● Capacity: 1TB / 2TB / 4TB ● Dimensions (L x W x H): 
● Form Factor: M.2 2280 80 x 22 x 3.43mm (with heatsink) 
● Interface: PCIe Gen4 x4 80 x 22 x 2.15mm (without heatsink) 
● NAND Flash: 3D NAND ● Weight: 9.2g / 0.32oz (with heatsink) 
● Sequential read/write (Max.): Up to 7,400/6,500MB/s (PC/laptop) 

6.2g / 0.22oz (without heatsink) ● MTBF: 1,500,000 hours

● Terabytes Written (TBW)(Max. capacity): 2,400TB

● Shock Resistance: 1500G/0.5ms ● Warranty: 5-year limited warranty 
● Operating Temperature: 0°C-70°C ● Certifications: CE, FCC, BSMI, KC, EAC, RCM, morocco, 
● Storage Temperature: -40°C-85°C UKCA, RoHS

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4TB | 7,400 | 6,500 | 2,400TB |
| 2TB | 7,400 | 6,500 | 1,200TB |
| 1TB | 7,400 | 6,000 | 600TB |
